description: Is a Florida inlet or pass stacking up? The old rule of thumb, worked out hour by hour for the next 12 hours: an outgoing tide running out into an onshore wind stands the waves up. 35 inlets and passes on both coasts and the Panhandle (Haulover, Government Cut, Port Everglades, Boca, Jupiter, Sebastian, Ponce, the St. Johns jetties, East Pass, Boca Grande, Gordon Pass, Big Pass, Longboat...). Says if it's rough now, when it eases (the next low or the wind), or when it turns rough later. Give a position for the nearest ones, or an inlet name.

lat.description: Latitude of where the person is or will be

name.description: Or part of an inlet or pass name, e.g. Haulover, Jupiter, East Pass, Boca Grande
